//: The ONE list of the page's security headers. tools/build.mjs writes the policy into out/index.html (as a meta tag, without frame-ancestors, which a meta tag cannot carry); server/dev-router.php sends them from this file; tools/package.mjs writes them into the live .htaccess. test/headers.test.ts checks all three agree. Each outside address has its reason in 'why'.

why.'wasm-unsafe-eval': The built-in AI (Chat Agents): lets the page run WebAssembly, the compiled program WebLLM uses on the graphics chip. It does not allow JavaScript eval or scripts from text.
why.https://huggingface.co: Chat Agents: a built-in AI model that is NOT saved on this TOMLIN OS, or one a person added, is fetched from Hugging Face, where its makers publish it; Find AI models searches it. Only model files and the search; nothing typed to an AI is sent.
why.https://*.hf.co: Chat Agents: Hugging Face hands its model files out from its file servers (us.aws.cdn.hf.co and the like), to which huggingface.co redirects.
why.https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlc-ai: Chat Agents: the model's small WebGPU program, published by the WebLLM project (the MLC team) on GitHub, for a model not saved on this TOMLIN OS. Only that project's folder, not all of GitHub.
why.'script': Trusted Types: the browser refuses any string put into the page as HTML or script (the usual way injected code gets in). The one exception is src/core/inert.ts, which reads an email's HTML, or HTML pasted into TOMLIN Write, into a document that is never shown.
why.tomlinos-inert: Trusted Types: the only policy allowed, the one in src/core/inert.ts; no other code can create one.

headers.Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), payment=(), usb=(), serial=(), bluetooth=()
